Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

omnis

omnis, omne

adjective, third declension; in the plural, all (people, things)

all; in the singular, every; every; all, every; the whole of (a thing taken as one)

In this lexicon

  • all

    the recommended word · classical · Verg. Ecl. 8.63: nōn omnia possumus omnēs; Liv. 21.54.5: ut prandēre omnēs jubērent

  • every

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 65: nōn omne vīnum; Hor. Ep. 1.4.13: omnem crēde diem tibi dīlūxisse suprēmum

  • whole

    also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.1.1: Gallia est omnis dīvīsa in partēs trēs

  • omnis generis: range

    classical
